summary: New 95% C.L. axion-electron bound g_ae < 1.49e-13 from RGB TRGB-RGBB differential method is correctly identified, matches abstract/Fig.14, uses standard dimensionless g_ae with no conversion, and the highlighted one-sided upper bound shades continuously upward with a legible label.

verdict.summary: New 95% C.L. axion-electron bound g_ae < 1.49e-13 from RGB TRGB-RGBB differential method is correctly identified, matches abstract/Fig.14, uses standard dimensionless g_ae with no conversion, and the highlighted one-sided upper bound shades continuously upward with a legible label.

result_identity.evidence: Title/abstract (p.1) and Sec.7/p.12: Levasseur, Straniero & Caputo 2026, AxionElectron coupling g_ae from RGB stars (TRGB-RGBB). Coupling_type AxionElectron matches.

novelty.evidence: Abstract (p.1) and Sec.8 derive a new measured bound via a novel distance-independent differential observable; is_projection=false. Proposal records the combined WL2011 95% value. Though comparable to existing Red-giant (omega Cen) bounds, it is a genuine new independent measurement.

confidence_level.evidence: 95% C.L. upper limit explicitly stated: abstract 'a 95% C.L. upper limit of 1.49', Sec.7/p.12 'combined 95% C.L. upper limit of 1.49', and Fig.14 legend '95% upper limit = 1.49'. Not inferred/placeholder.

conventions.evidence: Paper defines g13 = g_ae/1e-13; standard dimensionless g_ae, no unit/density/polarization conversion needed. Mass-independent light-axion bound consistent with axion treated as effectively massless (Sec.2 core T~8.6 keV). Plot method fills a flat line at 1.49e-13 with no transformation.

numerical_agreement.evidence: Data file value 1.49e-13 matches abstract headline (g13=1.49), Sec.7 text (p.12) and Fig.14 ('95% upper limit = 1.49'). Flat curve at 1.49e-13 across both endpoints (1e-11, 1e4 eV).

highlight_target.evidence: Highlighted PNG shows the RGB (Levasseur 2026) region shading continuously upward from g_ae~1.49e-13 to the top of the plot across ~1e-11 to 1e4 eV - correct one-sided upper-bound topology, no finite band from occlusion, no wrong-side shading, no unrelated co-highlight. Label matches this result.

visibility.evidence: Full plot shows mass range (1e-11 to 1e4 eV) and coupling ~1.49e-13 on-screen with legible 'RGB (Levasseur 2026)' label; boundary interpretable despite proximity to existing Red giants (omega Cen)/XENONnT bands.

findings.description: The right-hand vertical boundary at 1e4 eV is the extractor's chosen plotting extent (approx core temperature), not a mass limit measured in the paper.
findings.evidence: Data header and extraction notes state 'mass endpoints are plotting extents, not measured mass limits'; the paper (Sec.2) quotes no explicit mass range. Disclosed and physically motivated.
findings.requested_change: None required; consider noting the mass cutoff is an applicability estimate if desired.
